name: poolside-copilot-chat
description: Use hosted Poolside coding models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your Poolside API key.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by Poolside-hosted Laguna models. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. laguna-xs-2.1 measured fastest and cleanest; laguna-s-2.1 is an alternate that receives an explicit thinking-off switch.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsChatInp.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsDebounc.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsTimeout.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsMaxToke.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsPrefixL.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

poolsideCopilot.inlineSuggestionsSuffixC.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

poolsideCopilot.reasoningEffort.description: Default Poolside thinking mode. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value.

poolsideCopilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from Poolside hosted models. Use 0 to reserve 32,768 response tokens. Positive values are capped by the model output capability and context window.

poolsideCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of a Poolside inference request in seconds.

poolsideCopilot.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed Poolside response data before aborting a request.

poolsideCopilot.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the Poolside hosted-model catalog is reused before refreshing.

poolsideCopilot.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the Poolside output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

apiKey.title: Poolside API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this Poolside provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.
